sources.description: After the game, Head Coach Sean Payton referenced the popular singing competition show The Voice when talking about the preseason finale. When asked about his message to players on the roster bubble and why the last preseason game matters, he told reporters, “Hey, make us spin the chair.” One player who came out of nowhere […]
